text.title: What customers signed for against what they are billed
text.lede: Each customer is a line from the contracted monthly amount on the left to the billed amount on the right. A level line is billed correctly. A line that tilts is not, and it takes the colour of the side that is higher: orange climbs, blue falls.
text.chartTitle: Monthly value per customer, contracted and billed
text.chartSub: March 2026 invoices, in USD. Tolerance is 1.00. The scale is compressed at the top so small accounts stay readable.

records.name: Caxton Freight
records.reason: The January price rise was applied twice in billing.

records.name: Dunlin Hotels
records.reason: Two invoices were raised for March, one by the renewal job and one by hand.

records.name: Foxton Marine
records.reason: A 20% first-year discount expired in February. Billing still applies it.

records.name: Jarrow Steel
records.reason: Twelve seats were added in billing with no contract amendment.

records.name: Mossley Print
records.reason: The customer downgraded in the sales system. Billing was changed, the contract record was not.

records.name: Quorn Dairy
records.reason: A rounding difference on the per-seat price, inside tolerance.

records.name: Selby Grain
records.reason: Billing prorated the month for a renewal that had no gap.

records.name: Usk Valley Water
records.reason: An add-on module is billed that sales recorded as a free trial.

records.name: Wyre Aerospace
records.reason: Signed on 2 March and live. No subscription was ever created in billing, so nothing has been invoiced.

records.name: Yeo Ceramics
records.reason: Contract active. The billing subscription was cancelled by mistake during a card update.

records.name: Zennor Hotels
records.reason: Still billed monthly. The contract ended in December and was never renewed.
